summary: dLocal Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court of New York unanimously affirmed the dismissal of a securities class action lawsuit against the company. The court held that all claims regarding alleged misleading statements in the IPO registration statement lacked merit. This is a legal victory, not an event-driven special situation. No deal terms, transactions, or strategic changes are involved. What to watch: any potential appeal by plaintiffs, though unlikely given the unanimous ruling.
